# Helper to fetch a single page from arXiv API and return parsed root
def fetch_page(start=0):
    query = 'all:multimodal%20OR%20all:RAG'
    url = f'http://export.arxiv.org/api/query?search_query={query}&start={start}&max_results=20&sortBy=submittedDate&sortOrder=descending'
    resp = web_fetch(url=url)
    if resp.get('status') == 200:
        return ET.fromstring(resp['content'])

page_num = 0
max_pages = 20  # safety limit

        break

        id_elem = entry.find('atom:id', ns)

            continue

        for link in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
            if link.get('rel') == 'alternate' and link.get('type') == 'text/html':
                abs_link = link.get('href')
                break

        # Simple filter: keep papers that mention "multimodal" or "vision" or "image" in title/summary
        text = (title + ' ' + summary).lower()
        keywords = ['multimodal', 'vision', 'image', 'visual', 'video', 'audio', 'speech', 'cross-modal', 'crossmodal', 'vlm', 'vision-language', 'vision language']
        if any(kw in text for kw in keywords):
            papers.append({
                'title': title,
                'summary': summary,

                'link': abs_link

for i, p in enumerate(papers):
